Pay: $100,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Join a highly respected litigation team recognized as one of Denver's Best Places to Work.
  • Handle sophisticated construction and casualty litigation with meaningful responsibility from day one.
  • Gain hands-on courtroom experience, including depositions, motion practice, client interaction, and case strategy.
  • Work alongside accomplished attorneys who are committed to mentorship and your long-term professional growth.
  • Enjoy a collaborative, team-first culture where your contributions are valued and your development is prioritized.
  • Earn discretionary and production-based bonuses while building a long-term legal career.
  • Benefit from unlimited PTO, hybrid flexibility, excellent benefits, and a strong commitment to work-life balance outside of litigation deadlines.

Location: Denver, Colorado — Enjoy a flexible hybrid schedule that combines in-office collaboration with work-from-home flexibility.

Note: Applicants must be licensed to practice law in Colorado. We are seeking attorneys with at least 2 years of litigation experience and a genuine interest in construction litigation. Prior construction litigation experience is strongly preferred but not required. Relocation assistance is not available.

About Us

We're a highly regarded boutique litigation firm dedicated to representing businesses, developers, contractors, and insurers in complex construction and casualty disputes. Our team is known for delivering exceptional legal work while maintaining a collaborative, supportive culture where attorneys are trusted with meaningful responsibility and encouraged to grow professionally. Confidential Employer.

Job Description

  • Manage litigation matters from initial case evaluation through resolution.
  • Draft, review, and argue motions in state courts.
  • Conduct depositions of parties, witnesses, and expert witnesses.
  • Develop litigation strategy alongside experienced attorneys and clients.
  • Perform legal research and prepare persuasive legal briefs.
  • Participate in mediations, settlement negotiations, and trial preparation.
  • Collaborate directly with clients, experts, and insurance professionals.
  • Manage discovery, case deadlines, and court filings.
  • Mentor junior team members as your experience grows.
  • Deliver exceptional client service while maintaining efficient case management.

Qualifications

  • Active Colorado Bar license required.
  • 2+ years of litigation experience.
  • Strong legal writing, research, and analytical skills.
  • Experience drafting motions and managing litigation files.
  • Deposition experience preferred.
  • Excellent communication and client relationship skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Construction litigation experience strongly preferred but not required.
  • Genuine interest in developing a long-term construction litigation practice.

Why You Will Love Working Here

You'll join a firm where attorneys receive real responsibility instead of simply supporting senior lawyers. We believe in collaboration over competition, mentorship over micromanagement, and providing opportunities to build courtroom experience early in your career. You'll work with experienced litigators on challenging cases while enjoying flexibility, outstanding benefits, unlimited PTO, bonus opportunities, and a culture that genuinely invests in your success.

JPC-1550

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement plan
  • Vision insurance

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Information Assurance and Security, Lead Associate . This position will perform the following duties (but not limited to):

This role is 100% Remote.

  • Provides technical and programmatic information assurance services to internal and external customers in support of network and information security systems.
  • Designs, develops, and implements security requirements within an organization’s business processes.
  • Prepares documentation from information obtained from customer using accepted guidelines. Excellent writing, documentation, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Prepares security test and evaluation plans.
  • Provides certification and accreditation support in the development of security and contingency plans and conducts complex risk and vulnerability assessments.
  • Analyzes policies and procedures against Federal laws and regulations and provides recommendations for closing gaps.
  • Recommends system enhancements to improve security deficiencies.
  • Develops, tests, and integrates computer and network security tools. Secures system configurations and installs security tools, scans systems to determine compliancy and report results and evaluates products and various aspects of system administration.
  • Conducts security program audits and develops solutions to lessen identified risks.
  • Provides information assurance support for the development and implementation of security architectures to meet new and evolving security requirements.
  • Provides assistance in computer incident investigations.
  • Performs vulnerability assessments including development of risk mitigation strategies.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years with BS/BA; 3 years with MS/MA; 0 years with PhD

  • Must be a U. S Citizen

  • Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Must have experience with EMASS
  • Must be Security + Certified or have Certified Info System Security Professonal CISS
  • Knowledge of DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (s) (i.e., CISSP, CISM)
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with information security standards, policies and practices – NIST SP 800-53 rev4, SP 800-37 rev2, FIPS-199, NIST 800-171
  • Demonstrated experience writing information system security documentation (System Security Plans (SSP), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Experience using vulnerability assessment tools (NESSUS, ACAS) and analyzing results

Desired Qualifications:

  • RMF (Risk Management Framework) Process, STIG Scans, IA Requirements

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

About Aragon

Aragon is an early-stage AI photo and video platform building its go-to-market function out of Canada. The company operates through an employer of record in Canada and is growing its sales pipeline through a direct outbound motion, targeting business customers across North America.

Founded: 2022 | Team size: 11–50 | Stage: Pre-seedIndustry: AI ToolsWebsite: aragon.aiOffice: Remote (Canada)

Why Candidates Should Join

  • First BDR hire, build from zero: Own the entire outbound motion end to end and stand up the pipeline function from the ground up.
  • Clear path to AE: Strong performance in this seat is a direct route into an Account Executive role within the organization.
  • Early-stage AI product: Join a 2022-founded, pre-seed AI media platform selling into business customers across North America.

Intake Call Summary

  • Not present in source. An intake video is posted on the Contrario role page, but no transcript or written summary was provided. Do not fabricate — request the intake summary or watch the video if a written summary is needed.

The Role

Aragon is hiring its first Business Development Representative to build the sales pipeline from the ground up. Fully remote in Canada, working closely with the Vancouver-based Head of Sales. The BDR owns the outbound motion end to end — sequences, cold calls, and lead sourcing that converts into real pipeline — with a direct path to promotion into an Account Executive seat.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and own the outbound pipeline through cold email, cold calling, and multi-channel sequences targeting prospective customers
  • Set up and manage outbound systems and tooling to support scalable lead sourcing
  • Source and qualify leads that feed directly into the sales team's pipeline
  • Attend and represent the company at conferences and industry events, traveling approximately five to ten times per year
  • Collaborate closely with the Head of Sales to refine targeting, messaging, and outbound strategy

Sales stack: Outbound multi-channel sequencing, cold-calling, and lead-sourcing tooling. Specific tools not stated in source.

Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years outbound BDR experience
  • Quota-carrying track record, meeting or exceeding targets
  • Cold calling and cold email as primary daily activities
  • Based in Canada (Vancouver or West Coast preferred)
  • Native or near-native English fluency required
  • Willingness to travel to conferences 5 to 10 times per year

Green Flags

  • Exceeding quota in current or prior role
  • Hands-on outbound experience, not just support
  • Canadian tech startup or D2C brand background
  • Degree from a recognized Canadian university
  • Exceptional new graduate with competitive or athletic background

Red Flags

  • Not hitting quota in current or prior role
  • Too much experience, especially at the AE level
  • Short stints across multiple jobs without clear context
  • Not based in Canada or unwilling to be
  • Not a native or near-native English speaker

Role Details

  • Salary — $60K–$70K CAD base ($80K–$100K CAD OTE). Contrario structured field shows USD equivalent of base: $42,700–$49,800.
  • Equity — Competitive equity
  • On-site policy — Fully remote, based in Canada (Vancouver / West Coast preferred; other Canadian cities considered)

  • Travel — Conferences and industry events ~5 to 10 times per year (travel included)
  • Visa sponsorship — None available; candidate must have existing Canadian work authorization
  • Employment type — Full-time
  • Location — Canada (remote)

Interview Process

Stage 1 — Intro Screening Call — Initial get-to-know-you conversation to assess fit and background.Stage 2 — Mock Cold Calls — Live practice calls to assess outbound instincts and phone presence.Stage 3 — Mock Calls + Mini Take-Home — Additional call practice combined with a short take-home exercise covering outbound setup.Stage 4 — Full-Day Work Trial (1 day) — A full day of work to assess real output, working style, and culture fit.Stage 5 — Offer ExtendedStage 6 — Candidate Hired — Candidate accepts and starts.

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in UK, France or Germany

About the RoleThe Senior Solution Consultant as a fully proficient professional will be responsible for understanding Kinaxis customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and will be committed to helping our customers solve complex issues in their supply chain management practice. The incumbent will work with new and existing customers and will provide expert guidance in integrating our product offerings so that our customers can start to experience the immediate value of Kinaxis solutions.The incumbent will act as a functional lead on projects by providing consulting services and leadership during deployment of RapidResponse supply chain software and leverage advanced knowledge of the product and supply chain industry trends and best practices to achieve desired outcomes.

Key Responsibilities• Independently lead business requirements discovery sessions for implementations of advanced complexity, multi-phase workstreams and broad scope.• Partner with Solution Architect in the process design and technical direction of complexconfigurations.• Execute product configurations of advanced complexity, according to customer needs and approved solution architecture.• Act as the first level of escalation and oversee the troubleshooting and resolution of complex configuration issues for the project team.• Apply advanced mathematical models, optimization techniques and artificial intelligencealgorithms to complex supply chain planning scenarios to improve customer supply chainperformance and achieve business objectives.• Execute the validation and testing of the solution, capture user feedback and developrecommendations for escalations, roadblocks, and documentation.• Independently lead complex deployment workshops with a focus on training and guiding customers on how the solution was configured and how to achieve immediate value from their investment.• Provide technical leadership and recommendations to the Associate, Entry and Intermediate Solution Consultants during project milestones and critical deployment escalations.• Guide and mentor more junior consultants throughout the project lifecycle. Primary Skills and Qualifications• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.• 5 + years of in-depth experience in software implementation or deployment within the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space or business experience in supply planning, demand planning, inventory management, manufacturing.• 2 to 3 years’ experience in a functional leadership capacity for system configuration or system deployments.• 2 to 3 years’ experience in business process design for supply chain software implementations.• Passion for working in customer-facing roles and able to demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication facilitation and presentation skills.• Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills, able to synthesize a high volume of complex information to determine best course of action.• Self-starter who shows initiative in their work and learning and can excel in a fast-paced work environment.• Proven leadership skills within a team as well as a successful track record with customers and executive sponsors.• Ability to work in a collaborative matrixed environment with multiple team members.• Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.Role Specific Skills and experience• Advanced level knowledge and hands-on application of supply chain best practices and concepts as it relates to forecasting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), Constraint Management, and Production Scheduling.• Ability to lead complex business requirements gathering sessions with customers and system end users.• Experience working with supply chain processes and manufacturing planning solutions such as RapidResponse/Maestro SAP, Oracle or Blue Yonder applications to support supply chain activities.• Proficiency in SQL, R and/or Java Script.• Open to travel 75% on average and 100% occasionally and can work effectively when working remotely from client sites

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Outpatient (OP) Coding Trainer to develop, deliver, and evaluate training programs for outpatient medical coders. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on coding experience in Emergency Department (ED), Same Day Surgery (SDS), and Observation (OBS) coding, along with a strong background in training, coaching, and quality improvement. This role is responsible for ensuring coders achieve and maintain high levels of coding accuracy, productivity, and compliance with industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and facilitate instructor-led and virtual training programs for outpatient medical coders.
  • Deliver comprehensive training on Emergency Department (ED), Same Day Surgery (SDS), and Observation (OBS) coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, and coding guidelines.
  • Conduct onboarding training for new hires and ongoing education for existing coders.
  • Assess trainee performance through coding exercises, knowledge assessments, and competency evaluations.
  • Provide individualized coaching and feedback to improve coding accuracy, productivity, and overall performance.
  • Develop and maintain training materials, job aids, reference guides, and standard operating procedures.
  • Stay current with annual coding updates, payer regulations, CMS guidelines, and industry best practices, incorporating changes into training content.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance, Operations, and Coding Leadership to identify knowledge gaps and implement targeted training initiatives.
  • Support quality improvement efforts by analyzing audit findings and creating action plans to address recurring coding errors.
  • Track training effectiveness and maintain records of attendance, assessments, and competency results.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for outpatient coding and provide guidance on coding-related questions from trainees and operations teams.
  • Ensure all training programs align with organizational policies, client requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.

Qualifications

  • Active CPC and COC certification required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Outpatient (OP) medical coding experience, including:
    • Emergency Department (ED)
    • Same Day Surgery (SDS)
    • Observation (OBS)
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Coding Trainer, Educator, Coach, or Learning & Development Specialist in a healthcare or revenue cycle environment.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, CMS guidelines, NCCI edits, and payer-specific coding requirements.
  • Experience using electronic health record (EHR) systems such as Epic, Cerner, Meditech, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency with coding encoder tools (e.g., 3M Encoder, TruCode, EncoderPro) is preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, coaching, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage multiple training initiatives while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

Responsibilities

Peraton is delivering advanced mission planning, digital engineering, and command‑and‑control capabilities supporting the U.S. Government’s space communications enterprise. Our team uses modern MBSE practices to translate mission needs into precise, traceable, and verifiable technical requirements across a complex, multi‑system environment.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will contribute to the design and development of core platform services that support secure, scalable, and reliable satellite ground communications and data‑transport capabilities. You will develop frontend and backend architectures, implement mission‑critical services, and participate in technical decision‑making that ensures consistent, resilient, and compliant system performance for U.S. Government missions. In this role, you will create backend components, collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams, and ensure technical solutions align with system requirements and program objectives.

What you’ll do:

  • Build multi‑tenant backend services on public cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Architect, develop, and consume APIs and backend services with an emphasis on automation, security, testing, and maintainability.
  • Create software system designs from business requirements and translate functional needs into technical specifications.
  • Present technical designs and recommendations to engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Test teams to ensure alignment between requirements, models, and system implementation.
  • Develop backend services using Python, including APIs, automation logic, and platform‑level components.
  • Design user interfaces (UI) and implement reusable front‑end software components to support consistent, accessible, and maintainable application functionality.
  • Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms,
  • Develop microservices and associated service‑to‑service communication patterns.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues using structured diagnostic and troubleshooting methods.
  • Support customer and partner integration activities as part of platform deployment and capability development.
  • Solve complex technical challenges related to secure and scalable satellite communications infrastructure.

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • Associate degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field and 10+ years of relevant experience; OR Bachelor’s degree in a related field and 8+ years of experience; OR Master’s degree in a related field and 6+ years of experience; OR Doctoral degree in a related field and 3+ years of experience. An additional four (4) years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
  • This position requires the candidate possess a minimum Secret clearance. The candidate must maintain the clearance.
  • Proficiency in Python development for backend systems and APIs.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing relational databases, including SQL, triggers, functions, and stored procedures.
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms, including RBAC and ABAC.
  • Experience with microservice development and backend service architectures.
  • Proficiency in developing software using TypeScript, including use of modern language features, strong type checking, and practices that support maintainable and reliable code.
  • Experience developing and building front‑end applications using Vite and associated modern web development tools.
  • Experience with contemporary front‑end development practices, including component‑based architecture, state management techniques, application routing, and responsive design.
  • Experience using Git‑based source control systems and participating in structured code review processes.
  • Experience investigating and resolving production issues in operational environments.
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and automated test workflows.
  • Working knowledge of PKI concepts and asynchronous messaging architectures.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OAuth 2.0, JWT, Git, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, Kafka, and Unix shell scripting.
  • Experience applying Zero Trust software development principles.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm for containerized deployment and orchestration.
  • Experience with at least one major commercial cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Desired qualifications:

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with MBSE and Test engineering teams.
  • Ability to prepare and present technical designs and recommendations to cross‑functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to engage with end‑users to clarify requirements or support implementation activities.
  • Ability to learn new tools, technologies, or frameworks in support of evolving project needs.

Benefits:

At Peraton, our benefits are designed to help keep you at your best beyond the work you do with us daily. We’re fully committed to the growth of our employees. From fully comprehensive medical plans to tuition reimbursement, tuition assistance, and fertility treatment, we are there to support you all the way.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results. The EHS Compliance Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and operational support for Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) administrative functions and ensuring accurate entry and maintenance of safety-related documentation within Ferrellgas systems. The role requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to complete assigned tasks accurately and in a timely manner.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Provides administrative support and coordination for Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs across field operations to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Administers and maintains administration of the EHS management system by entering, maintaining, and ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with company and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepares, formats, maintains, and distributes EHS materials and resources for field personnel.
  • Assists with reporting and data analysis by generating routine and ad hoc reports, identifying trends, and providing information to support leadership decision-making.
  • Coordinates with teams to support timely completion of safety initiatives, compliance activities, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Reviews Motor Vehicle Records (MVRs) for all new hire candidates and evaluates Safety Performance History reports for prior DOT-regulated employment; communicates findings and recommendations to Field Management.
  • Manages ongoing compliance for DOT-regulated employees, including MVR reviews, medical certification tracking, and timely follow-up on expirations or issues.
  • Maintains confidential employee and safety records while ensuring the integrity and security of sensitive information.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma required, bachelor’s degree in related field preferred. 2+ year(s) of experience in propane operations, safety, compliance, transportation, or a related operational environment is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Adobe Acrobat, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work load.
  • Ability to adjust and adapt to changes in work flow.
  • Ability to identify problems and present solutions.
  • Strong oral, written and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong trend analysis skills.
  • Strong safety ethic.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

raw.description:
Role Summary

The Project Engineer I within our EPC Client Services team supports utility-scale solar, BESS, substation, and related infrastructure projects. This role operates under the direction of a Senior Project Manager. You’ll manage defined scopes, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, track schedules and budgets, maintain document control, and proactively identify risks. For smaller projects, you may serve as the day-to-day lead with oversight. Strong organization, follow-through, and judgment are essential.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Manage defined project scopes under the direction of a Project Manager, ensuring alignment with contract requirements and client expectations.
  • Coordinate internal discipline teams and external subconsultants to support timely and accurate deliverables.
  • Track project schedules, budgets, and progress against milestones; proactively identify risks or scope changes and escalate as appropriate.
  • Support preparation and submission of monthly invoicing and assist with financial tracking.
  • Maintain organized document control, including meeting minutes, action items, RFIs, submittals, and record drawings.
  • Review deliverables for completeness and conformance to project standards prior to submission.
  • Apply established project management procedures with sound judgment and increasing independence.

Client & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for internal team members and support client communications under the direction of a Project Manager.
  • Participate in client, consultant, and subcontractor meetings; prepare agendas, document key decisions, and track action items.
  • Ensure alignment between client requirements, project scope, and internal execution plans.
  • Communicate schedule updates, risks, and scope clarifications clearly and promptly.
  • Coordinate with discipline leads to confirm deliverables meet client standards and contractual obligations.
  • Support proposal development efforts through coordination of scope inputs, schedule assumptions, and project data.

Collaboration & Team Support

  • Coordinate closely with discipline leads to ensure tasks are clearly defined, assigned, and delivered on schedule.
  • Facilitate internal alignment across engineering, drafting, and project management teams.
  • Provide clear status updates and escalate issues that may impact scope, schedule, or budget.
  • Support workload planning by helping prioritize deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, accountable team environment through proactive communication and follow-through.
  • Mentor junior project engineers or support staff on project processes and documentation standards as appropriate.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting project deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field or an associate’s degree in a related field plus substantial relevant industry experience.
  • Some level of of project management experience in an engineering consulting environment, renewable energy, or similar industry, including internships and coops.
  • Demonstrated ability to track schedules and basic project financials and support invoicing under PM direction.
  • Strong capability managing project documentation, meeting notes, action logs, RFIs/submittals, and deliverable tracking with high accuracy.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex project issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Preferred

  • Experience in renewable energy engineering, development, or construction environments.
  • Familiarity with the renewable energy project development lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

  • Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the us since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of immigrants, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp-eng.com

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Sales Compensation Advanced Analyst to support the design, administration, and optimization of global sales compensation programs.

This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate commission calculation, operational scalability, and alignment between sales incentives and company growth objectives in a complex, global SaaS environment.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in commission systems, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to operate both strategically and operationally.

Responsibilities

Commission Operations & Execution

  • Calculate monthly and quarterly commissions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and audit readiness
  • Validate commissionable transactions, including new bookings, renewals, upsell/cross-sell, and adjustments
  • Manage exception handling, including clawbacks, givebacks, credit adjustments, and dispute resolution
  • Support pay file preparation and payroll submissions

Plan Administration & System Management

  • Translate compensation plans into system logic, including quotas, tiered structures, accelerators, and incentives
  • Maintain and optimize sales compensation systems (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or similar tools)
  • Partner with Sales Operations to ensure accurate hierarchy, territory, and crediting structures
  • Support quota letter generation and plan documentation

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

  • Produce regular reporting on attainment, commissions, and cost of sales
  • Perform variance analysis and identify trends or anomalies in commission results
  • Provide insights to leadership on plan effectiveness and sales behavior
  • Support forecasting and accrual processes in partnership with Finance

Controls, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, audit requirements, and accounting standards
  • Maintain strong controls over data integrity, adjustments, and payout approvals
  • Support internal and external audits

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with:
    • Sales Operations (quota, territory, hierarchy)
    • Human Resources (eligibility, employee lifecycle changes)
    • Finance and Accounting (accruals, reporting, compliance)
    • Order Management (booking and revenue validation)
  • Serve as a point of contact for sales compensation inquiries and escalations

Continuous Improvement & Transformation

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve automation
  • Support system implementations, migrations, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Contribute to evolving compensation design as the business scales

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in sales compensation, finance, or sales operations, preferably in SaaS
  • Strong understanding of commission structures, including tiered plans, quotas, and accelerators
  • Experience with sales compensation tools (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, Oracle Incentive Compensation)
  • Advanced Excel skills, including modeling, reconciliation, and large dataset analysis
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting global compensation programs across multiple regions
  • Familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or other data and reporting tools
  • Experience with system implementations or process transformation initiatives
  • Understanding of SaaS metrics such as ARR, ACV, churn, and expansion revenue

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset
  • High degree of accountability and ownership
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to manage complexity and ambiguity
  • Continuous improvement and automation mindset

Why This Role Matters

This role directly supports sales productivity, financial accuracy, and operational scalability by ensuring compensation programs are executed accurately, trusted by the field, and aligned to company growth objectives.

Why Join One Identity

-Collaborate with talented, driven professionals who are passionate about technology and customer outcomes

-Gain exposure to enterprise-grade sales, partners, and complex deal cycles

-Develop end-to-end sales skills, not just top-of-funnel activity

-Enjoy real ownership, visibility, and clear pathways for career growth

-Benefit from a culture that values innovation, teamwork, wellbeing, and performance

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, weintend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide.Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers, and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses. Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

Why work with us?-Life at One Identity means collaborating with dedicated professionals with a passion for technology.-When we see something that could be improved, we get to work inventing the solution.-Our people demonstrate our winning culture through positive and meaningful relationships.-We invest in our people and offer a series of programs that enable them to pursue a career that fulfills their potential.-Our team members’ health and wellness are our priority, as well as rewarding them for their hard work.

One Identity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: One Identity is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Job Location: Mumbai, IN

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Areas Of Responsibility

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

Job Summary:

The Infra / Cloud Architect is responsible for the strategic design, roadmap definition, and engineering governance of the organization's global IT infrastructure and cloud landscape. This role spans across data center technologies, cloud platforms, networking, security, and hybrid infrastructure models. The architect acts as the bridge between business needs and technical delivery, translating enterprise goals into scalable, secure, and cost-optimized solutions across geographies.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Architecture Strategy & Blueprinting
    • Define and maintain the global infrastructure and cloud architecture blueprint.
    • Align designs with business continuity, scalability, cybersecurity, and performance goals.
    • Champion platform rationalization and simplification initiatives.
  2. Solution Design & Project Enablement
    • Architect infrastructure solutions for large programs (e.g., DC transformation, AD consolidation, hybrid cloud migration).
    • Review and approve HLDs, LLDs, and BoM submitted by partners or internal teams.
    • Validate architecture compliance in global IT programs.
  3. Technology Evaluation & Adoption
    • Evaluate emerging technologies such as Zero Trust, SD-WAN, SASE, Edge Computing, and Infra-as-Code.
    • Define proof-of-concept initiatives and guide technology onboarding.
  4. Architecture Governance & Standards
    • Own and enforce architecture principles, standards, and reference models.
    • Conduct architecture reviews and design approval boards.
    • Ensure compliance with InfoSec, GxP, and SOX frameworks.
  5. Collaboration & Knowledge Enablement
    • Partner with delivery, cybersecurity, and service teams to translate designs into build/run.
    • Coach engineering teams and upskill delivery units on architectural best practices.

Specialized Knowledge Requirements

  • Deep expertise in enterprise architecture across compute, storage, network, identity, and cloud
  • Advanced knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid models
  • Strong grasp of cybersecurity principles and compliance mapping to infrastructure design
  • Familiarity with automation and orchestration (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD)
  • Understanding of ITIL, TOGAF, and regulatory requirements in pharma/life sciences

Internal Stakeholders and Nature of Interaction

Role Summary

The Chief Digital Assets Officer (CDAO) is responsible for leading the organization's digital assets strategy, including tokenized assets, digital securities, cryptocurrencies, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), custody solutions, and blockchain-enabled financial products. This executive role oversees the development, governance, commercialization, and regulatory compliance of digital asset initiatives while driving innovation and sustainable growth in the evolving digital economy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Assets Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital assets and tokenization strategy.
  • Identify opportunities for digital asset adoption, monetization, and business growth.
  • Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on digital asset trends, risks, and market developments.
  • Establish long-term digital asset roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

2. Digital Asset Product Development

  • Lead the creation and commercialization of digital asset products and services.
  • Oversee tokenized investment products, digital securities, stablecoin initiatives, and custody offerings.
  • Drive innovation in digital asset trading, settlement, and asset management solutions.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of digital asset platforms.

3. Tokenization & Digital Securities

  • Develop tokenization strategies for financial instruments, real-world assets, and alternative investments.
  • Lead digital securities issuance and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Evaluate opportunities in asset tokenization and fractional ownership models.
  • Drive adoption of blockchain-enabled financial infrastructure.

4. Digital Asset Operations & Custody

  • Oversee custody frameworks and asset protection mechanisms.
  • Ensure operational resilience and secure management of digital assets.
  • Implement governance controls for wallets, private keys, and settlement processes.
  • Establish operational best practices and service standards.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with digital asset regulations and financial market requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Information Security functions.
  • Manage regulatory licensing, reporting, and audit obligations.
  • Monitor developments from regulators and industry bodies affecting digital assets.

6. Market Development & Strategic Partnerships

  • Build partnerships with exchanges, custodians, financial institutions, fintechs, and blockchain providers.
  • Develop strategic alliances to expand digital asset capabilities and market access.
  • Represent the organization within digital asset industry forums and working groups.
  • Support ecosystem growth and institutional adoption initiatives.

7. Technology & Innovation

  • Partner with technology teams to develop blockchain-based digital asset infrastructure.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies supporting digital assets and tokenization.
  • Drive innovation in settlement, custody, interoperability, and smart contract capabilities.
  • Support integration of digital assets into existing financial systems.

8. Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and lead high-performing digital asset, product, operations, and compliance teams.
  • Develop internal expertise in digital assets, tokenization, and blockchain technologies.
  • Manage budgets, investments, and vendor relationships.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, governance, and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Technology, Computer Science, Law, or related field.
  • MBA, Master's degree, CFA, JD/LLB, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in financial services, capital markets, asset management, fintech, digital assets, or blockchain-related sectors.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior executive leadership role.
  • Proven experience with digital assets, tokenization, digital securities, custody, or blockchain-enabled financial products.
  • Strong understanding of capital markets, financial regulations, custody operations, and digital asset ecosystems.

Key Competencies

  • Digital Assets Strategy
  • Tokenization & Digital Securities
  • Capital Markets & Asset Management
  • Blockchain & Distributed Ledger Technology
  • Digital Asset Custody & Operations
  • Cryptocurrency & Stablecoin Ecosystems
  • Regulatory Compliance & Governance
  • Risk Management
  • Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
  • Product Innovation & Commercialization
  • Executive Leadership
  • Financial Services Transformation

About the Job

Do you remember your favorite teacher—the one who inspired you and went above and beyond to help you achieve your goals? Do you aspire to pay it forward? Join a rapidly expanding team dedicated to cultivating future leaders capable of achieving their maximum potential. Where other test prep companies simply hire part-time tutors looking for a side gig, our after-school college prep institution hires full-time instructors looking to grow their careers in a collaborative and growth-oriented start-up environment. We do not teach “tricks” or how to “beat the test.” Rather, we utilize an organic approach that builds students’ essential core skills, improving their writing and reading skills in the long term—not just for the SAT or ACT, but for high school, college, and beyond.

As a Math Instructor, you will be expected to:

  • Instruct small “core” groups of students in their mathcore skills to promote long-term understanding of topics and top scores in their college readiness exams (ACT & SAT).
  • Track your student’s progress as they move through Vanguard’s unique multi-phase curriculum, engaging students in individualized growth and improvement opportunities along the way.
  • Model professionalism and strong organizational skills by replying to students promptly, maintaining and updating student lesson schedules on our online platform, and holding students accountable for assignments.
  • Spearheaded the development and creative execution of ever-evolving lesson plans and curriculum.
  • Mentor middle and high school students with empathy and an innate understanding that the college application process is becoming increasingly competitive and stressful.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in mathematics, education, or related STEM field (Master’s or higher preferred; open to those entry-level).
  • Teaching experience in math and/or experience working in a college-level tutoring center (1+ years).
  • GPA of 3.5 or higher.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, and G-Suites.
  • Access to a reliable internet connection and a workspace with minimal noise/distraction.

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • Experience teaching at the college or community college level.
  • Robust understanding of classroom pedagogy, and the ability to create customized, engaging lesson plans that use practical, real-world examples to inspire a love for learning.
  • Desire to help students recognize, reach for, and realize their fullest potential.
  • A dynamic and outgoing personality.
  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Mastery of SAT and ACT Math, especially the following subjects:
    • Pre-Algebra.
    • Algebra I & II.
    • Geometry.
    • Trigonometry.
    • Statistics.

Why you want to teach with Vanguard College Prep:

  • Paid training and comprehensive preparation.
  • A distinctive and individualized approach to test prep with a strong track record of producing top-tier students and nationally-ranked test scores.
  • Opportunity to work with our distinctly engaged, enthusiastic, and driven client base of students energized by Vanguard’s commitment to the highest-quality client experience.
  • An elite team of instructors, counselors, and specialists from Ivy League and top universities across the nation who are passionate about fostering student success.
  • Quickly growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and leadership, with opportunities for long-term career growth.
  • Competitive compensation structure (dependent on experience) with benefits.

Compensation:

  • Starting Pay: $21.00 – $24.00 per hour depending on education, experience, and skill.
  • A comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off, sick days, and paid winter vacations.

About Vanguard College Prep:

Vanguard College Prep is a full-service educational company whose mission is to enable the future leaders of our globalized world to meet their fullest potential. Through its test prep, college counseling, and college essay services, Vanguard is committed to providing meaningful, all-encompassing college preparation that treats each student as an individual, preparing them for the boardroom, not the assembly line.
Two things set Vanguard apart from other after-school companies: our elite team and our personalized, organic curriculum. Unlike other test prep companies, which often take a one-size-fits-all approach to test prep, Vanguard recognizes that every student learns differently. Our experienced instructors, counselors, and essay specialists strive to shatter this assembly line model by focusing on core learning rather than short-term strategies and tips, tailoring instruction to fit each student’s individual needs. We encourage students’ continual questioning and curiosity to extend learning beyond the classroom so that our students will be successful in the elite college of their choice and beyond.

Salary: $21 – $24 / hour

Responsibilities

The Senior BO/ETL Test Engineer will be responsible for leading the quality assurance, data validation, and end-to-end testing of enterprise reporting solutions, universes, and underlying data structures.

In this role, you will:

  • You will split responsibilities between hands-on report and universe testing (verifying WebI, Crystal Reports, and `.unx`/`.unv` semantic layers)
  • You will backend database/ETL validation (writing complex SQL to perform source-to-target mapping verification).
  • You will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, and Scrum/Kanban teams to ensure alignment with data accuracy, reporting performance standards, security requirements, and Agile delivery expectations.

Qualifications

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Bachelors and 5 years of overall tech experience in QA/ETL testing, with 3+ years specifically focused on testing SAP BusinessObjects reports, dashboards, and universes or Masters and 3 years experience.
  • Strong test plan and test script development experience, specifically tailored for data warehousing, ETL processes, and complex BI environments.
  • Deep functional understanding of SAP BusinessObjects suites (Web Intelligence, Crystal Reports, IDT/UDT Universes) and how security/RBAC models impact report data visibility.
  • Hands-on experience verifying complex data transformation logic, structural changes, and validating data completeness from source systems to BO target reports.
  • Must have advanced SQL skills for writing complex queries, joining disparate tables, and validating massive data sets across databases (e.g., Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server) to compare against report outputs.
  • Demonstrated experience using automated testing frameworks, scripting (Python, shell scripting, or Java), or BI-specific regression testing tools to streamline testing workflows.
  • AWS experience (verifying data stages, working with S3 external stages, and testing cloud-based source data).
  • Ability to work independently and effectively with little to no supervision.
  • Team player with excellent executive function, meticulous attention to detail, and strong communication skills.
  • Must have the ability to obtain a Public Trust.
  • US Citizen or Green Card holder

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience validating BO environment migrations, platform upgrades, and regression testing reports across version updates (e.g., moving from BO 4.2 to 4.3).
  • Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience; certification preferred.
  • Relevant QA or SAP certifications (e.g., ISTQB Certified Tester, SAP Certified Application Associate).
  • Experience validating automated BI deployments and continuous integration/continuous testing (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • CLI Linux experience and testing automation in cloud-native data architectures.
  • Performance and load testing experience (testing report execution speeds, load capacities, and query optimization impact on database compute resources).
  • Experience working with Centers for Medicare and Medicaid (CMS) information systems.
  • CMS/Medicare or Medicaid claims data experience.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Project Manager, Auth to join our team at zerohash, you will play a critical role in executing and delivering complex, cross-functional software projects aligned with our product roadmap. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders - owning a specific product and technology vertical end-to-end, from project initiation through to production roll-out.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized, technically-savvy project manager to be part of a fast-growing fintech at the cutting edge of blockchain innovation.

Responsibilities

  • Organise teams in JIRA: releases, milestones, sprint planning and ceremonies
  • Own the zerohash delivery calendar for your squads and drive ceremony rhythm
  • Create and maintain dashboard reporting across delivery, release and velocity
  • Facilitate delivery end-to-end: scoping → sizing → development → testing → validation → sign-off → prod roll-out
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, manage dependencies and drive execution
  • Maintain delivery plans, surface risks early and ensure on-time, high-quality delivery

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in technical project management
  • Experience in fintech, blockchain, or cryptocurrency companies
  • Mastery of Jira and the Atlassian product suite
  • Proven track record of managing complex, cross-functional software development projects
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail
  • Experience working with remote or globally distributed teams
  • Strong understanding of simple and secure account linking and authentication infrastructure, including wallet integrations across custodial and non-custodial platforms, chain abstraction mechanisms, stablecoin funding integration, and the end-to-end lifecycle of account linking from user wallet selection through identity verification, account ownership validation, compliance confirmation, and secure asset transfer.

Benefits

We believe a happy, motivated, and healthy team is the best way to succeed. We offer the following benefits:

  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave
  • WeWork Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us
