About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Germany.

About the team

The role of Account Executive will be responsible for winning new business and revenue across the EMEA region and working with Kinaxis senior management to contribute to the overall growth strategy of Kinaxis. In return Kinaxis can offer an excellent environment to work where you will be a valued person and given all the associated benefits of an organization geared for growth and success.

What you will do

  • Leads efforts for identifying opportunities and growing revenue and new name accounts in EMEA
  • Working with Kinaxis senior management to develop the relevant account strategies and engagements to drive pipeline growth and close deals within agreed timelines
  • Highly credible and able to demonstrate understanding of the relevant client operations and strategies and linking them to the relevant solutions and high value propositions that go beyond just technology
  • Team player who is able to work and help ensure delivery of client sales propositions
  • Establishing and maintaining high-level, executive relationships with New Name Accounts, focusing on the establishment and maintenance of strategic relationships (direct and reseller).
  • Qualifying prospects according to Kinaxis’ capabilities and applicability.
  • Providing accurate sales forecasts and relevant reporting based upon realistic close timelines
  • Communicating product improvements and recommendations that originate in the field

  • Degree qualified with industry and scm experience preferred

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Successful applicants will contribute to the development of academically rigorous, engaging, and student-centred learning resources aligned with South African higher education standards, institutional quality assurance requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

  • Life Skills Teaching and Learning 3
  • Physical and Health Education
  • Educational Psychology 3: The Psychology of Learning

  • Ensure learning materials are current, academically sound, and incorporate relevant research and best practices.
  • Develop content that is suitable for distance and blended learning environments.
  • Ensure language accuracy, academic integrity, instructional quality, and consistency throughout all learning materials.
  • Collaborate with Programme Coordinators, Subject Matter Experts, Editors, and the Quality Assurance Office throughout the development process.

  • Ensure compliance with institutional quality assurance standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Meet all development milestones and submission deadlines.

Requirements

Required Competencies
Applicants must demonstrate:
  • Strong subject knowledge in the relevant discipline.
  • Excellent academic writing, curriculum development, and instructional design skills.
  • Sound understanding of curriculum development and assessment practices within higher education.
  • Knowledge of South African higher education policies, teaching and learning practices, and curriculum frameworks.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to academic quality.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple deadlines.
  • Excellent communication, planning, and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital learning platforms.
Minimum Requirements
  • A Master's degree in Education or the relevant discipline related to the module(s) applied for (essential).

  • Demonstrable experience in developing study guides, learning materials, or assessments within higher education.
  • Experience in distance or online education will serve as an advantage.
  • Familiarity with South African higher education quality assurance frameworks.
  • Computer literacy with access to a reliable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer.

  • A Doctoral qualification in the relevant field or current doctoral studies.
  • Previous experience developing learning materials for private higher education institutions.
  • Experience in Long Distance and e-Learning environments.
  • Knowledge of learning management systems and educational technologies.

  • Maintain and execute EVMS processes, including developing Control Account Plans (CAPs), tracking performance metrics, and preparing variance analyses.

Additional four (4) years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • This position requires US citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
  • Experience applying Earned Value Management System (EVMS) processes in a government or industry program environment.

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

We are seeking a Medical Director of Utilization Management to lead and support the clinical integrity of our utilization management (UM) functions, with a primary focus on inpatient and post-acute care reviews.

In this role, you will ensure timely, consistent, and appropriate care determinations for Commercial and Medicare Advantage members. By leveraging evidence-based practices, CMS regulations, and health plan benefit structures, you will evaluate the medical necessity of care, participate in peer-to-peer consultations, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to drive optimal clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, and cost efficiency.

Duration: August 10, 2026 – February 10, 2027

Location: Henderson, NV (100% Fully Remote Opportunity)

Reporting To: Chief Medical Officer

Start Date: Immediate Need

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilization Review & Medical Necessity: Conduct timely medical necessity determinations for inpatient admissions, continued stays, and post-acute care settings (SNF, IRF, LTACH, Home Health) for Commercial and Medicare Advantage populations.
  • Evidence-Based Evaluation: Apply nationally recognized guidelines (MCG, InterQual), CMS coverage criteria, and health plan policies to ensure appropriate level-of-care determinations.
  • Complex Case Escalation: Serve as the lead physician reviewer for complex, high-risk, or potentially adverse UM cases requiring clinical judgment.
  • Peer-to-Peer Engagement: Conduct peer-to-peer discussions with attending and treating physicians to clarify documentation, discuss options, and align on appropriate care plans.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Care Management and UM teams to identify utilization trends, reduce avoidable readmissions/extended stays, and streamline care transitions.
  • Policy & Quality Support: Offer clinical expertise to support quality improvement initiatives, regulatory audit preparedness (CMS/NCQA), policy development, and UM committee activities.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain precise, compliant, and timely documentation of all reviews and rationales in accordance with federal, state, and organizational guidelines.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Education & Licensure: Active M.D. or D.O. degree with an active, unrestricted medical license in good standing (in state of residence).
  • Board Certification: Current Board Certification in an appropriate medical specialty.
  • Clinical & Leadership Experience: Minimum of 5 years of clinical practice, including at least 3 years of direct experience in utilization management, physician review, or medical leadership within a managed care or health plan setting.
  • Population Expertise: Demonstrated physician-level experience supporting Commercial and/or Medicare Advantage lines of business.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Criteria Proficiency: Advanced expertise with MCG guidelines and strong working knowledge of InterQual and CMS criteria.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of Medicare Advantage regulations, Commercial health plan benefit structures, and state/federal UM mandates.
  • Technical Skills: Experience navigating medical management platforms, enterprise applications, and Microsoft Office products.
  • Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with a proven ability to handle delicate peer-to-peer discussions and articulate complex clinical rationales clearly.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a data-driven approach to identifying utilization trends and quality gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Public Health, Business Administration, or Health Administration (MPH, MBA, or MHA).
  • Certification by the American Board of Quality Assurance and Utilization Review Physicians (ABQAURP).

Why Apply?

This is a 100% remote, high-impact contract opportunity starting immediately, offering you the flexibility of working from home while managing key clinical determinations for a dynamic health plan environment.

Job Description: Chief Financial Crimes Officer (CFCO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Board Risk & Compliance Committee

Job Summary

The Chief Financial Crimes Officer (CFCO) is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise-wide financial crime prevention framework, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), fraud prevention, sanctions compliance, and anti-bribery & corruption programs.

This role ensures the organization is protected from financial crime risks while maintaining full compliance with regulatory requirements and international standards. The CFCO plays a critical role in safeguarding the organization's integrity, reputation, and operational resilience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Crime Strategy & Governance

Develop and implement a comprehensive financial crime risk management strategy

Establish governance frameworks covering AML, fraud, sanctions, and anti-corruption

Align financial crime programs with enterprise risk and compliance strategies

Promote a strong financial crime compliance culture

2. AML/CFT & Sanctions Compliance

Oversee AML/CFT programs, including KYC, CDD, EDD, and transaction monitoring

Ensure compliance with international standards (e.g., FATF) and local regulations

Manage sanctions screening and compliance frameworks

Ensure timely reporting of suspicious activities (STR/SAR)

3. Fraud Risk Management

Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation frameworks

Implement controls to minimize internal and external fraud risks

Leverage advanced analytics and monitoring tools

Coordinate fraud response and recovery efforts

4. Financial Crime Detection & Investigations

Lead investigations into suspicious transactions and financial crime activities

Ensure proper escalation and reporting to regulators and authorities

Collaborate with law enforcement and financial intelligence units (FIUs)

Maintain robust case management and documentation processes

5. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with all financial crime-related regulations

Manage regulatory inspections, audits, and reporting obligations

Maintain audit-ready documentation and controls

Monitor regulatory developments and adapt frameworks accordingly

6. Technology & Analytics

Oversee financial crime technology platforms (AML, fraud detection, sanctions screening)

Implement AI/ML-based monitoring and analytics tools

Enhance detection capabilities through data-driven insights

Drive digital transformation in financial crime management

7. Training & Awareness

Develop and deliver financial crime training programs

Promote awareness of AML, fraud, and compliance risks

Ensure employees understand reporting obligations and procedures

Foster a culture of vigilance and accountability

8. Stakeholder & Regulatory Engagement

Act as the primary liaison with regulators, FIUs, and law enforcement

Provide financial crime insights to executive leadership and Board

Collaborate with risk, compliance, audit, and business units

Represent the organization in industry forums

9. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop financial crime compliance teams

Establish performance standards and KPIs

Foster a culture of integrity and accountability

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, CFE, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in financial crime, AML, fraud, compliance, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior financial crime leadership roles (e.g., CFCO, Head of Financial Crime, AML/Fraud Leader)

Strong experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of AML/CFT, fraud, sanctions, and anti-corruption frameworks

Strong analytical and investigative skills

Expertise in financial crime detection and prevention technologies

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High ethical standards and attention to detail

Ability to manage complex regulatory environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Reduction in financial crime incidents and losses

Compliance with AML/CFT and financial crime regulations

Effectiveness of detection and monitoring systems

Timeliness and accuracy of regulatory reporting

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Employee awareness and training completion

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Exposure to advanced analytics, AI/ML, and regtech solutions

Strong relationships with regulators and law enforcement

Ability to manage complex financial crime risks

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

Title

This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Aprio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Modern enterprises run their most critical applications in complex, cloud-native environments, and the threats keep multiplying: outages, ransomware, bad actors, human error. Most disaster recovery tools stop at backing up data. We’ve built the next generation of cloud resiliency and disaster recovery for AWS and Azure with an automated, application-aware platform that recovers a company's entire application stack, not isolated resources, in under an hour. We protect production workloads for enterprises that cut across multiple industries like healthcare, financial services, and SaaS — the kind of companies that can't afford downtime.

At Arpio, we believe great companies are built by people who take ownership, move with urgency, and consistently deliver results. We just closed our $15M Series A to expand into new clouds and build out our roadmap, which means we're growing the team right now, and your work will directly shape where we go next.

About the Role

As our Senior Enterprise Account Executive focused on Microsoft Azure, you'll own one of the most strategic growth initiatives in our business.

You'll be responsible for developing enterprise opportunities, expanding executive relationships, and driving joint success with Microsoft. Working alongside our Microsoft Alliance Manager, you'll help build and execute our Microsoft go-to-market strategy while positioning Arpio as the preferred disaster recovery and ransomware recovery solution for Azure workloads.

This is a highly visible role with direct influence on our growth strategy, our Microsoft partnership, and the future of the company.

As enterprises continue moving mission-critical workloads to Azure, resilience has become a board-level priority. We're looking for a proven enterprise seller to help define how organizations think about cloud resilience while building one of Microsoft's premier cloud partner relationships.

This isn't simply another enterprise sales role.

It's an opportunity to help build a company.

What You'll Do

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. For this role, that looks like:

Own the Full Sales Cycle

  • Own the complete enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Own Arpio's Microsoft Azure business, partnering closely with our Microsoft Alliance Manager to build joint account plans, expand executive relationships, and execute our Microsoft go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans across enterprise Azure customers.
  • Generate qualified pipeline through executive prospecting, existing relationships, outbound strategies, and Microsoft co-sell activities.
  • Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Infrastructure Leaders, Cloud Architects, and executive decision-makers.
  • Partner directly with Microsoft Azure Account Executives, Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs), Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Technical Specialists, and Marketplace teams.
  • Execute Azure co-sell opportunities that create measurable business value for customers while accelerating Azure consumption.
  • Drive Azure Marketplace opportunities and collaborate on joint account planning with Microsoft.
  • Develop compelling business cases that align technical value with executive business outcomes.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders from discovery through contract execution.
  • Partner closely with Arpio Solutions Engineering throughout technical evaluations, demonstrations, and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Maintain forecast accuracy, disciplined CRM hygiene, and consistent pipeline management.

Build the Microsoft Partnership

Our Microsoft partnership is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Arpio.

Unlike many organizations where alliances and sales operate independently, you'll work as a unified team with our Microsoft Channel & Alliance Partner Manager to own Microsoft's field engagement within your territory.

Together, you'll:

  • Build relationships across Microsoft's sales and technical organizations.
  • Develop joint account strategies and executive engagement plans.
  • Identify and execute Azure co-sell opportunities.
  • Expand Marketplace adoption.
  • Increase Azure consumption through customer success.
  • Position Arpio as Microsoft's preferred cloud resilience partner.

Success in this role requires someone who understands that winning with Microsoft isn't simply about relationships, it's about delivering value for Microsoft, the customer, and Arpio.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has already proven they can win inside the Microsoft ecosystem.

Required qualifications include:

  • 5+ years of successful enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, data protection, or related enterprise technology sales.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota through enterprise new logo acquisition.
  • Direct experience selling solutions within Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Proven experience executing Microsoft Azure co-sell opportunities alongside Microsoft's sales and technical organizations.
  • Experience working directly with Azure Account Executives, Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs), Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Technical Specialists, or Marketplace teams.
  • Experience selling complex enterprise solutions involving multiple stakeholders and executive decision-makers.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior business leaders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and business case development skills.
  • A highly self-motivated, accountable individual who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

This is not an entry-level Microsoft role. We're looking for someone who understands how Microsoft sells, how Azure co-sell works, and how to build credibility with Microsoft's field organization from day one.

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won’t let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Arpio is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities; if you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know.

Overview

The Network Administrator is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining the organization’s network infrastructure, including on-premises and cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure. This role ensures network reliability, security, and performance through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation.

At this time, US Anesthesia Partners does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

The base pay estimate for this role is $55,300 - $88,400 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)

  • Installs, configures, and maintains network hardware, software, and Azure components including firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, Virtual WAN (VWAN), firmware updates, and cabling.
  • Performs routine backups, system updates, patching, and upgrades to maintain network integrity and security.
  • Monitors network performance, system alerts, and security logs to identify and resolve potential issues proactively.
  • Diagnoses and resolves network problems when alerted by users or automated monitoring systems.
  • Maintains accurate records of network configurations, procedures, and activities for compliance and troubleshooting purposes

Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2 years of experience in network administration or a similar role.
  • CompTIA Network+ certification, or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, VPN, and network protocols.
  • Experience with Azure networking (VWAN, VPN Gateway, NSGs).
  • Familiarity with firewalls, IDS/IPS, and network security best practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Experience with cloud networking and hybrid environments preferred.
  • Knowledge of scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python) preferred.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and SIEM platforms preferred.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Occasional Standing
  • Occasional Walking
  • Frequent Sitting
  • Frequent hand, finger movement

Overview

One Identity's OneLogin team is seeking Senior Software Engineers who operate with high ownership, strong technical judgment, and a bias for action. These roles are designed for engineers who identify and solve problems proactively — not just execute assigned work.

Senior Engineers at OneLogin are expected to operate as T-shaped engineers: deep in a primary domain while remaining capable across the stack (backend, APIs, cloud, and operations). You will play a key role in maintaining product velocity, improving system reliability, and reducing operational burden.

This is a hands-on role that includes on-call responsibilities and requires a strong commitment to modern engineering practices, including AI-augmented development. We are looking for engineers who take full ownership — design, build, test, deploy, and operate — rather than handing work off between silos.

In this role, you will focus on standardizing API development through tooling and automation, improving consistency, usability, and integration velocity across services. You will leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate API design, validation, and standardization — improving developer workflows and reducing inconsistency at scale.

Responsibilities

Standardize API development through tooling and automation so the right approach is the default

• Define and evolve API standards (OpenAPI), and enforce through tooling, automation, and CI/CD workflows (not manual review processes) • Build and maintain systems that auto-generate, validate, and enforce API specifications (contracts, schemas, validation) • Integrate AI into API development workflows to improve specification quality, consistency enforcement, and documentation accuracy • Reduce bespoke implementations by providing shared patterns, libraries, and templates for API development • Improve API consistency, discoverability, and usability across services • Enable faster internal and partner integrations through well-defined, reliable, and documented APIs • Partner with engineering teams to migrate legacy or inconsistent APIs toward standardized patterns • Make standardized patterns easy to adopt through strong defaults, documentation, and developer tooling • Build shared libraries, SDKs, and tooling that teams use directly when developing APIs

Ideal Experience:

• Deep experience with OpenAPI / Swagger and API contract design • Experience building or enforcing API standards through tooling (linting, schema validation, code generation, CI/CD integration) • Strong understanding of API lifecycle management — versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation strategies • Experience building shared developer tooling, libraries, or platforms that improve consistency across teams • Experience designing APIs for internal and external consumers (developer experience focus) • Familiarity with contract testing and schema validation approaches • Experience identifying and eliminating inconsistencies across APIs at scale • Strong systems thinking — ability to balance flexibility, standardization, and developer velocity • Experience using AI to improve API development workflows, including: • Generating and refining API specifications from code or usage patterns • Validating contracts and identifying inconsistencies across APIs • Improving documentation quality and discoverability • Assisting in API design decisions and schema evolution • Analyze API usage patterns and inform design, versioning, or deprecation decisions

Qualifications

Software Engineering

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience with ownership of production systems, reliability, or operational improvements.
  • Strong backend development experience (Ruby, Node.js, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, service contracts, API design, and software design principles.
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable, consistent, and maintainable APIs in production environments.
  • Experience working across backend services, APIs, and production systems.

Cloud & Production Systems

  • Experience building and operating services in AWS or similar cloud environments.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with observability, production debugging, and incident response.

On-Call & Reliability

  • Willingness to participate in a mandatory 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Experience responding to production incidents and contributing to reliability improvements.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Experience using, or strong interest in, AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor).
  • Ability to evaluate and refine AI-generated code, APIs, specifications, and developer workflows.

Company Description

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.

When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide. Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses. Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

One Identity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: One Identity is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at One Identity are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. One Identity will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. One Identity encourages applicants of all ages.

Job Location: Work at Home, Tennessee, United States

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Per Diem requirement: must be able to provide a minimum of 9 hours of availability per week. This is a 2:30p - 11p evening shift.

Qualified candidates must hold a current, unrestricted license in Tennessee and live within three hours of Nashville or Knoxville, TN to meet minimum qualifications for this position. If hired, must be willing and able to obtain additional licensure.

The MinuteClinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner (Provider) delivers patient care services through a remote technology platform. You will work in collaboration with a dedicated team of professionals as you independently provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above. Encounters are documented utilizing Epic.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

  • Dedicated virtual care providers must meet minimum requirements for remote care delivery, including: broadband connectivity, a quiet setting with a neutral background to conduct visits from, and the ability to uphold patient privacy per CVSH guidelines. Ability to hardwire into connection preferred.

  • While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to interact with customers in a remote manner, site, write, operate the computer and phone, speak intelligibly, and hear patient responses.

  • Specific vision abilities include the ability to view and read a computer screen and other electronic devices

Responsibilities:

  • Provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients. This includes education and treatment for pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention and safer sex practices.

  • Evaluate primary care, acute, chronically ill, and transitional care patients, in addition to providing healthcare education and counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

  • Provide patient counseling; inclusive of pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention/safer sex practices, contraceptive care counseling and medication management

  • Educate patients on health maintenance and respond to patient care inquiries

  • Document all patient care within an EHR according to MinuteClinic policies and procedures

  • Provide care and coordination of our patients with internal and external colleagues, including the broader patient centered medical home, ensuring the highest standard of care is provided for all patients.

  • Effectively work within a patient care team, including fellow Providers, Collaborative Physicians, paraprofessionals, Pharmacists and other members of the health care team

  • Work independently , prioritize and solve problems, take initiative, and advocate for their patients and their practice

Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates must be currently licensed in one of the following states to be considered: Tennessee

  • Minimum of two years of medically-relevant experience or equivalent

  • Effective verbal, written, and electronic communication skills

  • Outstanding organizational skills and ability to multi-task

  • Initiative, problem solving ability, adaptability and flexibility

  • Ability to work without direct supervision and practice autonomously

  • Is proficient with information management and technology

  • Capacity to collaborate with professional colleagues as necessary to provide quality care

  • Depending on the market, the ability to be proficient in both speaking and writing in additional languages not limited to but including Spanish may be required

Education:

Completion of a Master’s Degree level Family Nurse Practitioner program with current National Board Certification and State of Employment license to practice in the Advanced Practice Nurse role required

$37.66 - $81.11

  • Develop and implement enterprise data strategies aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements.

This role ensures that controls across financial, operational, and compliance processes are robust, consistent, and aligned with organizational risk appetite.

The CCO (Controls) plays a critical role in strengthening governance, preventing control failures, and enhancing transparency across all business functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Controls Framework

Ensure controls are effectively designed, documented, and implemented

Standardize control practices across business units

Continuously improve control effectiveness and maturity

2. Control Monitoring & Testing

Oversee control testing, monitoring, and validation processes

Implement continuous control monitoring systems

Identify control gaps and weaknesses

Ensure timely remediation of control deficiencies

3. Risk & Compliance Integration

Align internal controls with enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks

Collaborate with risk, compliance, and audit teams

Ensure controls support regulatory compliance requirements

Monitor emerging risks and adapt control frameworks accordingly

4. Financial & Operational Controls

Oversee financial controls, including reporting, reconciliation, and revenue controls

Ensure operational controls across processes, systems, and workflows

Strengthen fraud prevention and detection mechanisms

Ensure consistency in control execution

5. Governance & Policy Management

Drive digital transformation in control environments

7. Stakeholder Engagement

Provide control insights and reporting to executive leadership and Board

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop internal controls and governance teams

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

raw.description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

Please note: This is an unpaid position.

JerseySTEM is seeking skilled Agile Product Owners to help implement and execute transformational organization outcomes. The candidate will have demonstrated expertise and application of Agile methodologies, techniques and frameworks, a successful track record of driving and facilitating teams, commitment to continuous learning and mindset of relentless improvement.

Candidates will be evaluated by JerseySTEM's Operational Excellence Management team which includes a technical committee of Agile coaches and business managers.

Candidates will focus on one of following domains:

  • Outreach Information System : Built around a backbone of Salesforce augmented by a series of supplemental applications such as Email marketing integration, Quickbooks integration,...the OIS-PO will oversee the evolution of the current solution as the needs evolve and new integrations become available.
  • Human Resources Information System: Established around the Applicant Tracking System (iCIMS) and the Onboarding platform (Enboarder), the Product own will shepherd the evolution of our information system supporting the Human Capital department. (HRIS-PO)

Responsibilities

What can you expect in a Product Owner role at JerseySTEM:

  • Organize and oversee the requirement gathering and Business Analysis of the solutions to be developed.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog for an Agile team
  • Attend weekly meetings with the team
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs, and with the team to understand technical and practical constraints
  • Help clarify user stories, set acceptance criteria, answer questions
  • Review the team's progress periodically, and adjust the backlog as needed
  • Identify process and communications issues
  • Minimum time commitment: 5-7 hours/ week with committed work times, for a minimum 6 months period.

Qualifications

Technical Qualifications:

  • 3-4 years of experience as Product Owner or Project Manager in a Corporate setting preferred
  • Proven track record as a PO or Product Manager
  • Excellent communication, analytical, mentoring and problem-solving skills
  • Certified Product Owner (CSPO) , PMP, SAFe certifications preferred
  • Experience using Jira, Kanban Board, Slack

raw.title: Wholesale Account Executive, National
raw.excerpt: About JMAC Lending: With over 25 years of experience, JMAC Lending has established itself as a leader in the industry.
raw.description:
About JMAC Lending:

With over 25 years of experience, JMAC Lending has established itself as a leader in the industry. We pride ourselves on our innovative products, outstanding service, and unwavering commitment to supporting our partners in growing their businesses. Our culture revolves around surpassing conventional market options, positioning us as the preferred lender for our clients. Our team boasts impressive credentials and participates in ongoing education to blend knowledge with experience seamlessly. Built on a foundation of the highest ethical standards, our company excels in delivering competitive product pricing for wholesale and correspondent lending to our valued clients.

The Opportunity:

We're looking for a driven National Account Executive to grow a broker territory by reactivating a book of dormant accounts and layering in your own existing broker relationships. This role is built around a clear 6-month ramp: reactivate, re-engage, and build monthly funded volume to $5 million by month six, with the CRM and daily call discipline to support consistent, repeatable growth. You'll be equipped to sell the full suite of products we offer, with a primary focus on growing Non-QM production to represent 50% of the company's total monthly volume.

This is a Full-Time/Remote/Exempt opportunity offering competitive commission structures, with the unlimited earning potential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Call and reactivate a pipeline of deactivated/dormant broker accounts assigned by management, converting them back into active, funding partners.
  • Meet daily outbound call and contact activity requirements to maintain consistent pipeline coverage and broker engagement.
  • Log every call, contact, and account update in the CRM daily to keep pipeline data accurate and enable effective follow-up.
  • Bring and cultivate your own broker relationships, expanding the territory beyond the assigned reactivation list.
  • Ramp monthly funded volume on a defined growth curve, reaching $5 million in fundings per month by month 6.
  • Sell the full range of products offered by the company, with a primary focus on growing Non-QM production to reach 50% of total company monthly volume.
  • Learn, teach, and clearly explain underwriting guidelines and loan program requirements to brokers and their processing staff.
  • Guide brokers through file submission, status tracking, and issue resolution using the TPO portal.
  • Partner closely with underwriting, processing, and operations teams to move broker files through the pipeline efficiently.
  • Review call activity, CRM data, and volume progress against ramp targets in regular check-ins with management.
  • Stay current on guideline changes, pricing, and competitive positioning to effectively sell programs to brokers.

Ramp Expectations:

This role includes a structured 6-month production ramp. Account Executives are expected to progressively increase monthly funded volume from account reactivation and self-sourced business, reaching $5 million in monthly fundings by month 6, supported by consistent daily call activity and CRM discipline. While Account Executives sell across the company's full product suite, the core objective of this role is to drive Non-QM production to 50% of total company monthly volume.

Requirements

  • Prior wholesale mortgage account executive experience, with an existing book of broker relationships preferred.
  • Strong phone-based sales skills and comfort with high-volume, disciplined daily outbound calling.
  • Working knowledge of CRM systems and TPO portal file submission workflows.
  • Solid understanding of mortgage underwriting guidelines across the full product suite (agency, Non-QM, and government), with strong Non-QM knowledge and the ability to teach it to others.
  • A track record of hitting or exceeding funded volume goals in a wholesale or broker-facing role.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable being measured against activity metrics and monthly funding targets.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation & Holidays)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Family Leave
  • Wellness Resources

JMAC Lending, Inc. is an Equal Employment Employer. We are committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regards to age, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

DISCLAIMER: JMAC Lending is an evolving company. As such this job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

raw.title: Master Physician Advisor
raw.excerpt: Job SummaryEach year, MedSchoolCoach supports more than a thousand pre-medical and medical students as they pursue successful careers in medicine.
raw.description:
Job Summary

Each year, MedSchoolCoach supports more than a thousand pre-medical and medical students as they pursue successful careers in medicine. As physicians who have personally navigated the medical school and residency application process, we provide expert guidance grounded in firsthand experience.

We are seeking highly accomplished physicians to serve as Master Physician Advisors. This role is designed for physicians with extensive admissions expertise, significant mentoring experience, and a passion for helping future physicians succeed. Master Advisors serve as trusted experts, providing strategic, high-level advising to applicants throughout every stage of the medical school and residency application process.

This opportunity is ideal for retired physicians or physicians who have transitioned away from full-time clinical practice and are interested in dedicating 20+ hours per week to mentoring the next generation of physicians.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior advisor to pre-medical students applying to medical school.
  • Advise medical students applying to residency through the ERAS and NRMP Match process (when applicable).
  • Conduct comprehensive one-on-one advising sessions focused on application strategy, competitiveness, career planning, and professional development.
  • Provide expert guidance on school selection, application timelines, interview preparation, and admissions strategy.
  • Collaborate with writing advisors to develop and refine personal statements, secondary essays, activities descriptions, and residency application materials.
  • Conduct high-level mock interviews and deliver detailed, actionable feedback.
  • Share firsthand admissions committee and residency selection committee insights to help students better understand evaluation criteria and strengthen their candidacy.
  • Participate in webinars, educational content creation, blogs, workshops, and other thought leadership initiatives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and ambassador for MedSchoolCoach's advising program.

Required Qualifications

  • MD degree from an accredited U.S. medical school.
  • Successful completion of an accredited U.S. residency training program.
  • Significant experience serving on a medical school admissions committee and/or residency selection committee.
  • Minimum of two years of advising, mentoring, teaching, admissions, or residency selection experience.
  • Deep understanding of the AMCAS application process.
  • Strong knowledge of the ERAS application and NRMP Match processes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and inspire students from diverse backgrounds.
  • Highly available to students (20+ hours per week).
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Word, Zoom, Google Meet, Gmail, and other communication platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in academic medicine, medical education, or faculty leadership.
  • Experience interviewing and selecting medical school or residency applicants.
  • Previous experience advising students through successful medical school admissions and/or residency matching.
  • Retired physicians and physicians practicing part-time are strongly encouraged to apply.

About MedSchoolCoach

MedSchoolCoach is a rapidly growing EdTech company dedicated to helping future physicians achieve their goals through expert advising, tutoring, software, and educational resources. Founded and led by physicians, MedSchoolCoach has become one of the largest organizations in the medical education space, reaching nearly half of all prospective medical students each year through one or more of our products and services.

Working at MedSchoolCoach

We are a distributed team of physicians, educators, advisors, tutors, and entrepreneurs who share a passion for improving healthcare through education. We value collaboration, initiative, integrity, and a genuine commitment to student success.

Our team enjoys the flexibility of remote work while making a meaningful impact on the next generation of physicians. We strive to create an environment where every team member can contribute their expertise, continue growing professionally, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

I think this version creates a much clearer distinction between your standard Physician Advisor role and the Master level. It positions these physicians as true experts whose value comes not only from being physicians, but from their admissions committee experience, residency selection expertise, and strategic advising capabilities. It should also make sourcing easier because candidates can immediately recognize that this is a more prestigious, senior opportunity.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

raw.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

En Option, creemos en un mundo donde las soluciones tecnológicas no tienen límites. Nuestra misión es transformar los desafíos en oportunidades mediante la creación de soluciones innovadoras que potencien la Aceleración Digital. Nuestro equipo es dinámico, colaborativo y apasionado por la tecnología. Únete a una organización que está redefiniendo cómo el mundo utiliza los datos y la tecnología para resolver problemas complejos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Estamos en la búsqueda de un/a Data Engineer para formar parte del equipo DataOps. Este rol será clave en el desarrollo de productos de datos orientados a la optimización y eficiencia a gran escala. Si tienes experiencia trabajando en entornos GCP, te apasiona la automatización de procesos y el desarrollo de soluciones innovadoras, esta oportunidad es para ti.

¿Qué te ofrece este puesto?

  • Participar en proyectos desafiantes enfocados en la optimización de costos en plataformas cloud a gran escala.
  • Formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado, colaborando con expertos en DevOps y Data Engineering.
  • Un entorno de trabajo dinámico, con la oportunidad de impactar directamente en el rendimiento y costos operativos de la organización.
  • Un paquete de compensación competitivo y oportunidades de crecimiento profesional.

¿Cuáles serían tus principales desafíos?

  • Construcción y mantenimiento de plataformas de datos en el contexto de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), asegurando escalabilidad y resiliencia.
  • Optimización y eficiencia de costos a gran escala, considerando múltiples datasets, procesos y usuarios.
  • Desarrollo e integración de APIs para conectar servicios en GCP y mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios internos.
  • Automatización de procesos relacionados con la observabilidad, gestión de costos y despliegue de pipelines.
  • Orquestación y contenedorización de servicios utilizando Docker y Kubernetes para entornos distribuidos.
  • Estimación y análisis de costos asociados a productos legacy versus soluciones modernas orientadas a herramientas serverless en GCP.
  • Propuesta de mejoras arquitectónicas cuando se identifiquen casos patológicos en el uso de recursos.
  • Procesamiento y transformación de datos con librerías como Pandas, PySpark u otras herramientas de Big Data.

¿Qué necesitas para ser nuestro próximo/a Data Engineer?

Habilidades técnicas excluyentes:

  • Experiencia avanzada en Python (incluyendo librerías para análisis y manipulación de datos como Pandas, NumPy).
  • Dominio de SQL para consultas, modelado y optimización en bases de datos relacionales.﻿
  • Manejo de Terraform a nivel usuario (módulos, configuraciones).
  • Experiencia en entornos Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Conocimientos avanzados en optimización de costos en la nube.
  • Experiencia en el desarrollo de APIs.
  • Habilidades para automatizar procesos y gestionar grandes volúmenes de datos.
  • Experiencia en contenedorización y orquestación con Docker y Kubernetes.
  • Conocimientos en CI/CD y buenas prácticas de despliegue en entornos cloud.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% Remoto

raw.description:
Overview

We are looking for a technical powerhouse, not someone to just maintain the status quo. We are driven by a singular focus: cultivating a High-Performance Engineering Culture. We believe that excellence is driven by elite teams who embrace the future—from AI-augmented workflows to cloud-native architectures. We are seeking a technical lead who will eliminate engineering friction, raise the technical bar, and drive the hands-on execution of our modernization journey.

The Mission

Your goal is to technically lead and transform existing teams into high-performance units where Modern Engineering is the default. You will be the technical driving force in our journey of transforming our on-premise monolith product to a highly scalable, modern hybrid solution. You are responsible for architecting and delivering mission-critical systems where High Availability, resilience, and operational excellence are the standard.

Responsibilities

  • Domain Architecture & Execution: Translate high-level architectural visions into robust, scalable technical designs. Lead the hands-on development within our C#, C++, and Angular ecosystem.
  • Modernization & Data Strategy: Actively drive the technical transition toward an Event-Driven Architecture (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) and execute the decoupling of legacy monolithic databases into independent services.
  • Resilience, Scalability & FinOps: Build with "you build it, you run it" accountability. Architect components for High Availability and apply FinOps principles to ensure our evolving cloud footprint is resource-efficient.
  • Zero-Trust Security & Identity: Implement secure coding practices and integrate modern identity solutions using Azure AD and Entra ID into the core of your systems.
  • Technical Mentorship (Force Multiplier): Act as the technical role model for your team(s). Conduct rigorous code reviews, establish engineering best practices, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI tools in your daily development lifecycle to dramatically accelerate coding, testing, and debugging, setting the standard for your team.

Qualifications

  • You are a Master Builder & Problem Solver: You excel at taking complex technical challenges and independently structuring them into elegant, maintainable code and scalable architectures.
  • You are a Systems Thinker & FinOps Advocate: You instinctively design for fault tolerance and cost-efficiency, ensuring systems are self-healing and financially optimized.
  • You have deep expertise in Data Architecture & Messaging: You know how to untangle complex dependencies and build robust, event-driven integrations.
  • You believe in Total System Ownership: You know that a feature isn't done until it’s observable, stable, and delivering value in production.
  • You are a Collaborative Communicator: You can effectively bridge the gap between technical execution and product requirements, communicating clearly with Product Owners and Principal Engineers.
  • You are an AI Advocate: You understand how AI is redefining the engineering craft and actively use it to enhance your daily productivity.

What We Offer:

  • The autonomy to design and build critical systems within a market-leading global enterprise portfolio.
  • A high-impact role driving a massive-scale modernization effort (On-prem to Hybrid/Cloud).
  • Competitive compensation that recognizes your deep technical expertise, leadership, and impact on the team's delivery.

Company Description

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.

When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide. Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses. Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

One Identity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: One Identity is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at One Identity are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. One Identity will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. One Identity encourages applicants of all ages.

Come join us. For more information, visit us on the web at One Identity Careers | Explore Opportunities with the OI Team

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on quest.com/careers using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps like Telegram to communicate with applicants, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way and only interact with people claiming to be Quest employees if they have an email address ending in @quest.com or @oneidentity.com

Hello there, thanks for paying attention to our vacancy and let us introduce ourselves.

We are an IT company occupying a remarkable place in marketing, gaming, and financial segments of the iGaming industry. Our products are successfully implemented in European, African, and Latin American markets.

Ever since we first started, we have been driven to find the best solutions in everything we do. At the same time, we have been creating strong connections worldwide, which have helped us establish our presence in the industry.

We strive for fun, elegance, and efficiency in everything we do. You can feel this in our relaxed, homelike working environment. We offer employment and seek to hire only the brightest, most driven, and most gifted minds around.

Currently, we are looking for an ambitious Head of Compliance to join our team for full-time employment.

As Head of Compliance, you will lead and implement the global compliance strategy across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with international iGaming regulations, licensing requirements, and corporate governance standards.

You will oversee AML, KYC, responsible gaming frameworks, and regulatory relationships while supporting sustainable business growth and promoting a strong compliance culture across the organization.

Here are a few reasons to join us:

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 25 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Harness Software Engineering Insights (SEI) is where engineering meets engineering intelligence. As part of this team, you’ll work on a deeply technical product that connects to 40+ developer tools like Jira and GitHub, processes millions of events, and turns raw SDLC data into actionable metrics.

This is a product that engineers build for engineers, where you’ll see your work directly impact how thousands of developers build software. Expect challenges in data modeling, systems design, developer UX, and secure cloud integrations — all to help engineers and leaders build faster, better, and smarter.

About You

  • A desire to build products that solve complex technical problems for end users
  • Experience with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL
  • Experience with SQL query tuning, performance optimizations is a plus
  • Experience with search frameworks like Elasticsearch, SOLR is a plus
  • Experience with applications hosted on AWS/Azure/GCP is a plus
  • Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD processes is a plus
  • Deep understanding of how distributed resilient software is built and deployed
  • Excellent problem solving and debugging skills
  • Experience working in short release cycles

Ready to Build Something Engineers Love. This is your chance to shape the systems that shape how software gets built. Join Harness today!

Zero is a small team inside Metalab. We explore new tools, workflows, and ways of building products. We test ideas fast, validate what works, and feed learnings back to the broader org.

The role is client-facing. You'll be embedded in active engagements, putting our research to the test on real product work.

You design product experiences end-to-end and take them to ship: structuring flows, making the calls on hierarchy and interaction, then directing AI coding tools to turn your designs into working product. You push for working artifacts over polished mockups. You feed back honestly to the people building the tools.

If your work ends in Figma, that's good. If it ends in something the team can actually use, that's the point.

You're curious, adaptable, and excited that product design is changing in real time. This isn't a hand-off-to-engineering role. AI coding tools (Cursor, v0, Lovable, Claude, etc.) are becoming the bridge from design intent to shipped product, and you're the one wielding them to make it real.

What you’ll do

  • Design and ship product experiences across web, mobile, AI-native, and emerging interfaces
  • Translate ambiguous product briefs into working prototypes and shipped artifacts, not just static mockups
  • Use AI tools and agents as a core part of your workflow to design, prototype, and produce working code
  • Collaborate closely with engineering leads on larger products while independently owning implementation for prototypes, MVPs, and smaller products
  • Present work clearly to clients and internal teams, holding the line on design quality while moving at the pace the work demands
  • Build, test, and improve the design tooling and AI workflows themselves, feeding honest learnings back to R&D

Requirements

  • Product design experience at a digital product agency, studio, or consultancy
  • Strong UI/UX fundamentals: systems thinking, product intuition, and the ability to structure flows, interactions, and behavior thoughtfully under real client constraints
  • You don't just use AI, you build with it. Likely in your personal life and hobby time. You've used Cursor, v0, Lovable, Claude, or similar to ship something real
  • Comfortable enough with how frontend works (components, layout, responsive behavior, basic state) to direct AI coding tools effectively and recognize when the output is wrong
  • A bias toward making ideas tangible quickly, with the judgment to know when polish actually matters
  • Passionate about staying ahead of how AI is reshaping product design, with a personal point of view on what's working and what isn't
  • Happy working alongside R&D, taking experimental tools and folding the findings back into how the broader org designs
